predictions: Alright, this is getting a bit crazy. I'm pretty sure I've never posted the exact same record four weeks in row before, but here I am this season with four straight 17-8 weeks. Obviously, four times 17-8 brings me to 68-32 for the season (and still exactly 68% correct, just like after every week). At least I finally got two F division predictions right in the same week for the first time… pretty low bar for any sort of F celebration.

Match of the week: (A Div.) Jonesing for Mugs @ Show Me Your Tips. The first matchup within what would generally be expected to be the league's top three has a slightly different look to it, due to the week 1 upset that Jonesing took. I'm assuming Jimmie Jones makes his debut here, so this one is going to be a slugfest. I'll still take Show Me, 13-11.

Match #2: (B Div.) Projectile Dysfunction @ Hump Day! It hasn't been what you might call an easy run for these two so far (PD has a losing record in both SCkt and DCkt), but here they are, in the four-team fight for the B lead. I might have to go Hump until they drop one, 13-11.

Match #3: (H Div.) Flight Club @ Bangin the Wire. The three leaders in H have all faced the same three teams so far. And only Bangin came through that run unscathed, and they also did it with easily the most points. Looks like Bangin drops another contender two behind, 15-9.

Match #4: (F Div.) Runs with Corks @ Heart of Dartness. F has split itself into an early top-four/bottom-three grouping, and these are two of the very real contenders. Dartness is the clutch kings this past year, but the Corks are looking like the lead horse in this race. Corks, 14-10.

Match #5: (E Div.) Point of Attack @ D's Bad News Bears. Point of Attack got pushed pretty hard last week, and now they face the only remaining opponent that doesn't have 2+ losses already. The Bad News is good, but this still feels like a Point of Attack march, 16-8.

Match #6: (B Div.) Buffalo Bulls @ Mulligans Mafia. Yep, these are the bottom two teams in B. And they BOTH average over 10 points per week! With about one more dart per week, they could each be in the lead B group. Let's run with the Buffalos in this one, 14-10.

Match #7: (D Div.) Shooter McGavin @ Rif Raf. Only two D teams sit above 0.500, so a matchup of 2-2 squads could be defining who is the lead chase team. I think I'm kinda feeling Rif Raf lately, 14-10.

Match #8: (H Div.) Bright Side of Flights @ Double Vision. Bangin is setting the pace in H, but behind them the pack is a messy mix. Either of this pair could emerge as the top competitor. Vision, 13-11.

Match #9: (A Div.) Why So Serious? @ Dart Attack. Being one of the league's top four teams is a pretty bad ass claim, and Attack has been all over that so far. Maybe it's even top three? Attack, 16-8.
Match #10: (F Div.) Shark Shooters @ One Time. One Time just took a tough 1001 loss to the Corks, and they need to rebound against a Shooter squad that is in every match. One Time it is, 15-9.
Match #11: (G Div.) Death Throw @ Sofa Kings. Death Throw leads the G race, but Sofa just took out Nein Mark and is looking for a second big victim in a row. Death Throw escapes, barely, 13-11.
Match #12: (E Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ That's What She Said. Early battle to see who stays in E? Off Constantly, 14-10.
